text:
Mc6 is the obvious outlier. Every other current-starving NMOS (Mc0–Mc5, and the bias device Mb1) has W=15.06. Mc6 has W=2.26. That starves the pull-down of the last stage, which drives vout, so vout cannot reach the bottom rail and the swing drops.
